Focus this iteration on ONE of these requirement areas (pick the one not yet covered):
- Access control: authentication, authorization, role-based access, MFA
- Data protection: encryption at rest and in transit, data classification, retention
- Audit logging: event logging, log retention, monitoring, alerting
- Incident response: response plan, notification procedures, recovery
- Vendor management: third-party risk, data processing agreements
- Policy documentation: required policies, review cadence, training

Provide:

CURRENT_GAPS: [likely gaps given the current state described]
